data.content_ref: inline:Make reinstatement structural rather than emergent by precomputing defense chains up to a fixed depth d and adding a 'defense edge' from each defender to each node it defends through a chain of length ≤d; then run the ordinary grounded fixpoint on the enriched graph. Because d is fixed, the number of added edges is O(n^{d+1}), so polynomial cost is preserved. Reinstatement is still a derived property—of the enriched graph, not an extra decision rule—and committed-root validity is preserved because the enrichment only makes explicit already-valid defense structure.
